Design and construction notes  设计施工说明  l . Design specification and basis :  1.Design requirements and related information provided by owners and brand owners。 2.The relevant information provided by each professional in cooperation with the manufacturer。  II. Material description:  1、Material requirements: The exterior facade material is designed according to the drawing requirements, with a silver gray stainless steel honeycomb panel finish Wall: Newly built walls are all 100 # light steel keel partitions unless otherwise specified. Main construction materials： Grey Stainless steel plate with silver matte paint、Aluminum alloy silver gray skirting line、Micro Cement Texture Paint、 White matte lacquer、Metallic matte silver gray lacquer、 Flame retardant board、TILE  1.If the hanging bars in the ceiling exceed 1.5 meters, reverse support is required. If they exceed 2 meters, a transition layer (transition layer: use 40mm * 40mm * 3mm (minimum standard) angle iron for spacing) is required 800mm * 800mm grid leveling, with vertical angle iron spacing of 1600mm * 1600mm); 2.The ceiling keel must have sufficient mechanical strength (the main keel should be made of materials above 60, and the auxiliary keel should be made of materials above 50; the spacing between the suspension rods should be ≤ 800mm, the spacing between the main keel should be ≤ 800mm, and the spacing between the auxiliary keels should be ≤ 350mm; the thickness of the main keel should be ≥ 1.2mm, the thickness of the auxiliary keel should be ≥ 0.6mm, and the diameter of the suspension rods should be ≥ 10mm; a maintenance hole must be reserved below the ceiling equipment, with a size of not less than 600mm × 600mm, and the surrounding keel or corner iron ring should be firmly fixed, and hanging pieces should be installed; the walls of the ceiling and adjacent tenants in the public area should be sealed to the top, and the through wall holes should be closed. The finished surface height of the ceiling should be ≥ 3 meters; gypsum board installed on light steel keel can be Use of decoration materials.  III .Special notes:  In order to cater forInsta360's nationwide identity promotion and maintain the same design style, the construction party, supporting units and manufacturers are requested to carefully review the drawings before proceeding with the construction. For any problems not specified in this design set, your company or the project leader of the construction unit shall communicate with our company and we will respond as soon as possible. Thank you for cooperation! At the same time, please cooperate with us in terms of the following matters: -   Before and during the construction, the construction party must first review the drawings and prepare detailed construction and schedule plans. In case of any problems, please contact the designer immediately to explain the situation in detail. Any inconsistency between the site conditions and drawings, and relevant issues during the construction shall be submitted to the design team for confirmation before relevant construction processes are implemented, issues affecting the design shall be communicated with the design team for confirmation before the construction. It is not allowed to modify the plan or carry out construction without authorization; -   The construction party is required to print the construction drawings according to the size of the paper received, and must be constructed according to the drawings. All dimensions are not allowed to be measured directly in the drawing, and all dimensions shall be subject to the data marked in the drawing. -   After receiving the full set of drawings, please call our designer promptly to confirm the start date and demolition date, so that our supervisors can make their schedule accordingly and ensure timely and effective delivery of the works. -   After the demolition, the construction party shall measure the site dimensions and record the problem dimensions. Carefully review the construction drawings, and make a trial setout on the site. -   Our supervisors arrive at the site to confirm that the setting out is correct, and then carry out next step of construction; Confirm the component order at the same time. -   Please call the designer after the store is opened, and our company will arrange the completion acceptance of the store.  IV .Construction Note:  Design elevation and dimensions: 1. The elevations noted in the drawing are set with the elevation of ± 0.00. 2. All dimensions indicated in the construction drawing are in "mm", other than elevations, which are in "m". 3. The dimensions indicated in this construction drawing shall be subject to the dimensions indicated on the drawing, and shall not be measured and calculated according to the scale of the drawing. Fire protection design: 1. The fire protection rating of all fire doors shall be selected according to the original building design grade. See the materials shown in the elevation for the decorative surface. 2. Please see the table of materials for details of the fire rating of interior decoration materials of the building. Roofing materials shall be Class A non-combustible materials, and the floor and wall materials shall be Class B1 flame-retardant materials. 3. All base course materials shall meet the fire prevention and other requirements of special acceptance of fire control and quality inspection departments. 4. All walkway partition walls shall be built with floor slab (beam) bottom, transverse (vertical) holes and gaps on floor slab and partition wall, and seams and pipeline crossings shall be sealed and filled with non-combustible materials within the same fire resistance limit. Ceiling: Partition walls: 1. Unless otherwise specified, the light steel keel partition walls are made of 75 or 100 series keel; see the wall legend and detailed drawings. 2. Weigh light steel keel frame according to the board wall, light steel keel spacing ≤ 400MM, parts above and below should be fixed firmly. Then set the auxiliary keel and put on the keel connector. Inorganic coating wall finish: 1. For single-layer 12mm thick paper gypsum board, the interface of gypsum board must be on the keel with a gap of ±3MM, and the lines shall be strictly straight; 2. The gypsum board screws shall be rustproof with a spacing of < 250-300mm. The screws shall be tightened and the gypsum board shall not be damaged. All wood should be painted with fireproof paint. 3. The joint shall be leveled with special joint bandage, special glue and embedded with special putty. 4. All exposed iron parts shall be coated with red primer for rust prevention, and one primer and two top coats shall be applied in case of inorganic coating. Aluminum plate wall finish: 1. Inspect the wall quality, clean and reinforce. 2. According to the drawing, the stainless steel plate shall be separated and typeset in combination with the actual size on site. 3. Snap lines on the wall, embed the fixings and galvanized steel and metal fixings (for concrete walls, they can be directly fixed on the wall, and for light block partition walls, they can be fixed to the ceiling and floor or fixed on the ring beam). All structural fixings need to be galvanized to prevent corrosion. 4. Stainless steel finish, grooving and folding to ensure surface flatness and neat gap. The purchased materials and accessories can be used only after being checked and confirmed that they are qualified.  V.Other notes:  1. The design of this project shall beimplemented according to current regulations and construction regulations of China. In case of any conflict between this document and the regulations, please contact the designer. 2. The construction party must study and verify all dimensions and be responsible for them; in the event of any changes, the designer shall be promptly notified. 3. All selected materials shall be subject to the material samples; the construction party shall provide corresponding material samples, and only when they are approved by the designer and the owner could the construction work be carried out. 4. Relevant disciplines for water, electricity, wind and other relevant electromechanical works shall closely coordinate with each other during the construction. In case of any unclarity or inconsistency, please promptly contact the designer to resolve the issue together. 5. All ports on the decorative surface shall be factory made, and their colors shall be close to those of the finish materials unless otherwise specified. if any unclarity or inconsistency is found, contact the design party in time to jointly resolve it. 6. The construction party shall be responsible for the safety of finish base, large lamps, furniture, fixtures and other fixtures within the construction; for important parts, the corresponding embedding, reinforcement and installation drawings shall be provided to the designer for confirmation, to ensure safety. 7. Each supplier shall verify the size on the site to ensure that the installation is appropriate. If there is any doubt, the designer shall be promptly notified. 8. All construction processes and practices not mentioned in the design drawings shall be performed in accordance with GB50210-2001, Code for Construction Quality Acceptance of Building Decoration. 9. Please refer to the relevant drawings for the installation of water, electricity and air.  VI.Construction Requirements:  The construction party shall strictly comply with relevant laws and regulations regarding construction projects as well as the quality acceptance specifications regarding the building decoration projects. It is strictly forbidden to work without a permit, and the measures regarding the configuration of temporary electricity usage, noise, dust, odor, lighting, and public disturbance prevention during construction shall comply with relevant construction regulations. The person responsible for managing on-site workers of the construction party shall have relevant knowledge and professional capability in construction process, design, construction drawings, construction engineering regulations and specifications, communication and coordination.  Ground (floor tiles finish): 1. The ground shall be paved in strict accordance with the direction marked on the drawing line. 2. Base leveling: According to the design elevation of the floor, use 1: 3 dry hard cement mortar leveling, pull horizontal through line at the reference point for laying. Before paving and plastering the dry and hard cement mortar on the base course, the plain cement slurry shall be evenly plastered on the surface of the base course to increase the adhesion between the base course and the leveling course. 3. Floor tile laying, maintenance. Lamps, circuit: 1. Electrical installation and construction personnel shall be certified. 2. The lamps shall be installed in strict accordance with the direction marked on the drawing line. 3. The pipeline route, elevation and other positions shall be determined according to the position of lamps, sockets and distribution box in drawing. When wiring the power line, the cross section of the conductor used shall meet the maximum output power of the electrical equipment. The main power distribution box shall be placed in the warehouse as far as possible, and no rocker switch shall be set in the mall area. 4. Adjust the best illumination angle of lamps in time after the store is opened.
